_scenario: v0.0.2 TEST CASE 2 -- ZeroBus Ingestion to Bronze (single JSON column), TWO tables
_test_case_note: Two zerobus ingestion_flows stream two single-JSON-column source tables (metaflow.zerobus_v0_0_2.orders_event_bus and .devices_event_bus, each exactly one STRING column 'payload_json', created by notebooks/00_seed_sample_data/03_seed_v0_0_2_tc2_zerobus_json_bus.py) into two Bronze streaming_table targets. PAYLOADS INTACT: neither source_config sets json_string_columns, explode_columns or auto_flatten_all, so ingestion/json_flattening.py never runs -- the raw JSON document is landed as the same unparsed STRING it arrived as, one Bronze row per source row. column_normalization is likewise omitted so 'payload_json' keeps its exact name. COLUMNS THAT PROVE THE ASSERTIONS (all added because source_config.capture_technical_metadata defaults to true; real names verified in src/NextGen_Metadata_Framework/lakeflow_framework/ingestion/technical_metadata.py and engine/flow_registration.py, not guessed): ARRIVAL TIME -- __framework_ingestion_timestamp_utc (current_timestamp() at the moment the row was staged; attach_framework_ingestion_timestamp in ingestion/technical_metadata.py). LINEAGE -- __framework_pipeline_run_id (which pipeline update produced the row) and __framework_record_id (per-row identity), both stamped by engine/flow_registration.py::register_staged_view. Cross-flow lineage back to the originating bus is provable from the control tables via the per-flow source_system / source_database / source_table_name recorded below (control_plane/ddl_definitions.py lines 56-58), which differ between the two flows. The three file-level columns __framework_source_file_name / _size / _modification_time are attached by attach_technical_metadata but resolve to NULL for zerobus -- a zerobus source streams an existing Delta table, so there is no _metadata file struct to read; that is expected, not a defect, and those columns are NOT the lineage evidence for this test case.
